topic: 6sense 2026 B2B Buyer Experience Report: 81% of B2B buyers use AI in evaluation but only 26% to discover vendors; pre-contact favourite wins 82%
instagram_caption:
B2B buyers use AI to check you out, not to find you.

6sense surveyed 4,611 recent B2B buyers across North America, APAC, Europe and the UK and Ireland, in a report out on 2 Nov. 81% used AI somewhere in their evaluation, down from 94% last year. Only 26% used it to discover vendors. And the vendor buyers favoured before speaking to sales won 82% of the time.

Why it matters: AI is a checking tool, not a discovery engine. Buyers arrive with a shortlist already in their heads, then ask AI to confirm it. If you're not known before the search starts, a better prompt won't save you.

What to do this week:
1. Ask your last five customers where they first heard of you. Write it down.
2. Ask ChatGPT and Gemini to compare you with two rivals. Fix anything wrong or missing on your site.
3. Move some budget from bottom-funnel capture to always-on brand content your buyers see between purchases.

AI checks the shortlist. Your brand writes it.

linkedin_text:
B2B buyers use AI to check you out, not to find you.

6sense has published its 2026 B2B Buyer Experience Report, based on 4,611 recent buyers across North America, APAC, Continental Europe and the UK and Ireland. Three numbers stand out:

81% used AI somewhere in their evaluation, down from 94% last year.
Only 26% used it to discover vendors.
The vendor buyers favoured before contacting a seller won 82% of the time.

Our take: AI has become a checking tool, not a discovery engine. Buying groups form with preferences already in place, then use AI to test them. If your brand isn't known before the search begins, no amount of prompt optimisation will put you on the shortlist.

Three moves for this week:
1. Ask your last five customers where they first heard of you, and log the answers.
2. Ask ChatGPT and Gemini to compare you with two competitors. Correct anything wrong or missing on your website.
3. Shift part of your budget from bottom-funnel capture to always-on brand content buyers see between purchase cycles.

AI checks the shortlist. Your brand writes it.
